## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Use a Conventional Commit title, for example `fix: restore previews after GitHub navigation`.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` and `npm test`
- [ ] Packaged extension tested in Chromium, or explain why not applicable
- [ ] Documentation updated if behavior, permissions, or installation changed

## Release impact

State any version, permission, privacy, or compatibility changes. Tag a release only after this PR is merged and CI passes.
